summary: Iteration 13 re-checked the back-button bug from iteration 12 (back did nothing after a direct load or reload). The fix works: all 4 items pass at 375x667. (1) After a direct load or reload of /waiter/bill/3, bill-back-button goes to /waiter/table/3 and 'Tisch 3' is shown. (2) After a direct load or reload of /waiter/table/3, table-back-button goes to /waiter. (3) After a direct load or reload of /report, report-back-button goes to /waiter for kellner1, /owner for inhaber and /kitchen for kueche. (4) In-app navigation still goes back to the previous screen: /waiter -> table/2 -> bill/2 -> back -> table/2 -> back -> /waiter; waiter, owner and kitchen -> /report -> back -> home. No 'GO_BACK was not handled' message appeared, neither on the page nor in the console. No data was created or changed. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the reviewed files.

issues: Low priority, outside the scope of this check: old open orders show their age in minutes only, for example '12933 Min.'. Showing hours or days after 60 minutes would read better.

critical_code_review_comments: bill/[id].tsx:89, table/[id].tsx:110 and report.tsx:31 now use router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace(fallback). This is the same pattern as staff.tsx and settings.tsx. The canGoBack-or-replace pattern now appears in 5 screens; a shared useSafeBack(fallback) helper would remove the repetition (optional).
